name: Merged Agent Failure Taxonomy
description: Compact semantic merge of AgentRx Taxonomy and AgentErrorTaxonomy with complete, non-duplicated provenance coverage.

categories.name: Plan/Instruction Non-Adherence
categories.definition: Agent deviates from given directions or agreed plan, including taking actions that contradict the current plan (wrong action choice), under- or over-executing relative to policy/orchestrator steps.

categories.name: Invention/Hallucination of Information
categories.definition: Agent fabricates, alters, or omits information not grounded in inputs/context/tools, including "recalling" events or states that never occurred.

categories.name: Invalid Invocation/Action/Format/Parameters
categories.definition: Action/tool call is invalid due to nonexistent action, malformed format, or bad/missing/unreasonable parameters; failures stem from invalid inputs rather than logic.

categories.name: Misinterpretation of Outputs/Handoff
categories.definition: Agent misreads or partially considers tool/environment results or handoff outputs, leading to incorrect conclusions or next steps.

categories.name: Intent–Plan Misalignment / Constraint or Impossibility
categories.definition: Plan targets the wrong objective, has poor ordering/structure, ignores constraints, or proposes impossible steps under current conditions.

categories.name: Underspecified User Intent
categories.definition: Task cannot be completed due to missing or incomplete user-provided information at some point in planning/execution.

categories.name: Intent Not Supported (Capability/Tool Missing)
categories.definition: Requested intent/action is unsupported because the required capability or tool is unavailable.

categories.name: Guardrails or System Limits Triggered
categories.definition: Execution blocked by safety/policy/access restrictions or system-imposed limits (e.g., step caps); external limit rather than planning/execution error.

categories.name: System/Tool/Environment Failure
categories.definition: Failure due to external tool, system, or environment issues (e.g., connectivity, API errors, unpredictable behavior), independent of input validity.

categories.name: Inconclusive
categories.definition: Failure cannot be confidently mapped to other categories.

categories.name: Memory Oversimplification
categories.definition: Agent over-summarizes prior context, ignoring details and key factors, and bases decisions on oversimplified memory.

categories.name: Memory Retrieval Failure
categories.definition: Relevant information exists in memory but is not retrieved when needed.

categories.name: Progress Misjudgment
categories.definition: Agent misestimates progress toward the overall goal (overly optimistic or pessimistic).

categories.name: Causal Misattribution
categories.definition: Agent identifies an effect or failure but attributes it to the wrong cause.

categories.name: LLM Limitation
categories.definition: Failure due to intrinsic LLM response limits (e.g., context/generation constraints).

categories.name: Inefficient Plan
categories.definition: Plan could succeed but is unnecessarily inefficient, lengthy, or illogical.
